notes:
v0.6.18: BUILD.md verification gates + non-default-repo install paths.

Hardening pass after the operator's first clean build on
the new reticulumpi Pi surfaced 6+ recipe gaps. Each gap
delayed the build by 5-10 minutes because the failure
surfaced several steps AFTER the actual misstep. v0.6.18
adds verification gates right after every install/cp/enable
block so failures surface immediately.

Snags addressed (in the order they were hit):

1. `apt install zerotier-one` failed silently — the package
   isn't in the default bookworm repos. Added a Step 3a
   that adds the official download.zerotier.com apt source
   + signed-by key. Without this, `apt install zerotier-one`
   returns "E: Unable to locate package" and Step 6 fails
   with "Unit file does not exist" two minutes later.

2. `apt install pat` failed silently — same pattern. The pat
   package is in the default bookworm repos, so no new
   source needed; just verification.

3. After the .deb install for either package, dpkg's
   post-install runs `systemctl start` which can fail
   silently. Added a `dpkg --configure -a` step after each
   non-default-repo install.

4. `/lib/systemd/system/zerotier-one.service` (upstream)
   vs `/etc/systemd/system/zerotier-one.service` (manual
   write). Documented the precedence and the right way to
   handle it (delete the manual file once the upstream one
   is on disk).

5. /launcher-status 404 after git checkout. The systemd
   restart-after-checkout step was missing. Added explicit
   `systemctl restart g90-shared-launcher.service` after
   the working-tree pin.

6. LAUNCHER_DIR NameError at runtime when the launcher was
   running stale code. Same fix as #5 — explicit restart
   after the working tree change.

7. The 30+ line apt install block was a single heredoc that
   paste-mashed into one line, causing partial execution.
   Split into per-package blocks with comment headers so
   the operator can paste each independently.

8. The `start_my_launcher.sh` filename reference from an
   older BUILD.md version is misleading. Renamed the helper
   to be unambiguous (it's still `start_my_launcher.sh` at
   the repo root, just documented in a "dev helper" callout
   so it doesn't get confused with the systemd unit name).

9. Added a Step 7.5 "## Verification" table that lists every
   service + binary + file the recipe should produce, and
   what command to verify it. Operator runs the table
   bottom-up before declaring the build done.

10. The modem73 install (v0.6.15) is correct, but the
    `apt-cache policy modem73` check is now part of the
    verification table for consistency.

11. Removed references to patmenu2 entirely (was v0.6.17's
    commented-out "OPTIONAL" block). Cleaner to not have
    dead text in the recipe.

No code or overlay changes. Docs only. Captured image
state will be the same as v0.6.17's overlay; only the
recipe path to get there is hardened.

This release does NOT auto-deploy to the existing fleet
(g90digi, g90test) per the change-order rule. The operator
will validate the recipe against the new reticulumpi clean
build first, then I'll push to g90test + g90digi on the
next session.
